استهتروا (form X)
# اِسْتَهْتَرُوا (istahtarū) /is.tah.ta.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَهْتَرَ (istahtara)
# اِسْتَهْتِرُوا (istahtirū) /is.tah.ti.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَهْتَرَ (istahtara)
